name: io.github.330899935/hive-memory
title: Memory Hive
description: Local-first memory over MCP. Ships a working SQLite memory store, so it runs standalone. Agents propose; only you confirm. The optional Hive app adds encrypted vaults.

environmentVariables.name: HIVE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: auto (default) asks the Hive app and falls back to the local store only when the app is unreachable; local never touches the network; remote refuses to fall back.

environmentVariables.name: HIVE_DB
environmentVariables.description: Path to the local memory database. Defaults to ~/.memory-hive/hive.db. Only used when the local store answers.

environmentVariables.name: HIVE_AGENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Agent id issued by your own Hive app. Only needed for calls the app serves (HIVE_MODE=auto with the app running, or remote). Not required to use the local store.

environmentVariables.name: HIVE_AGENT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Access token issued by your own Hive app when the agent is registered. Only needed for calls the app serves.

environmentVariables.name: HIVE_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Hive app MCP endpoint. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8768/mcp
